prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1067; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, reporting neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with whiplash-type loading. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, while neurological screening and reflex testing were within normal limits. The reported mechanism of injury is well matched to the force and direction of the impact. No prior injury or complaints involving the cervical spine are known from the patient's history. Care was delivered over 19 visits and included manual therapy, guided home exercise, and short-term analgesia. Treatment progressed along a typical recovery course, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms improved and range of motion returned closer to baseline. Billed services reflect the treatment plan with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. Patient was discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
